---
title: "Tutorial"
description: "A linear SCNSim micro-course from primitive authoring to Direct, optimization, reusable composition, and pump-off HB."
anchor-sections: false
---

Follow the course in order. Each page answers one user question with one focused
operation and inspection. If an API has not been taught, the course does not
use it.

::: {.callout-warning title="Candidate package" appearance="simple"}
SCNSim remains `CONVERGING`. The course expresses the intended native V1 API,
but the current package is a fail-fast scaffold and produces no simulation
evidence.
:::
